personal.about: I am a Computer Science engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering, Mysuru. I enjoy building practical AI applications, developing data pipelines, working with LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation, and creating automation solutions that solve real-world problems. My experience spans machine learning, backend development, data analytics, and Microsoft Power Platform.

projects.title: Clinical Research AI Assistant
projects.description: Built an AI-powered clinical research assistant that retrieves and synthesizes clinical trial information using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, and ClinicalTrials.gov APIs.
features: Integrated ClinicalTrials.gov REST APIs to retrieve clinical trial information.
Used vector search and retrieval-augmented generation to provide context-aware responses.
Designed an AI assistant workflow for retrieving and synthesizing research information.
Organized retrieved information into useful summaries for clinical research exploration.

projects.title: Airline Operations & Performance Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Built an end-to-end analytics platform processing more than 1.67 million flight records using Python, Databricks, and PostgreSQL. Developed ETL workflows, designed a star-schema data warehouse, implemented Random Forest-based flight-delay prediction, and created interactive Power BI dashboards.
features: Processed, cleaned, transformed, and validated more than 1.67 million flight records.
Designed a PostgreSQL star-schema warehouse with fact and dimension tables for analytical queries.
Developed a Random Forest model to predict flight delays using historical flight data.
Built Power BI dashboards to analyze delays, cancellations, airline performance, and route-level trends.
projects.impact: Converted large-scale flight data into an analytics solution combining data processing, data warehousing, machine learning, and business intelligence.

projects.title: SkillSwap - Skill Exchange Platform
projects.description: Developed a peer-to-peer skill exchange platform that helps users share their expertise and connect with people who want to learn complementary skills.
features: Created a web platform for users to showcase skills and discover learning opportunities.
Implemented frontend and backend components for platform functionality.
Structured the application around user profiles and skill discovery.

projects.title: VoiceAuth Secure
projects.description: Developed a voice-based authentication prototype using audio processing and machine learning techniques to recognize speaker characteristics.
features: Used audio feature extraction techniques to represent voice samples.
Applied machine learning techniques for speaker recognition.
Used SQLite to support local application data storage.

projects.title: Smart Finance

Built backend REST APIs for application functionality.
Used charts to visualize financial information and spending trends.
Integrated database access into the application.
